body.x: 42tea showed cube product at ‘CES 2017 Unveiled’ which is held in Las Vegas from January 5th to 8th.

There are a lot of products for coffee, but not for tea however, 42tea’s cube product is now launched for whom enjoys tea. 42tea’s cube separates tea leaves directly and then send data to user’s mobile app and then recommends proper amount and temperature of water and tea.
After the user put the cube in the pot or kettle and then the water boils, cube lets user know the perfect timing to pour water via app.
When the boiling water is poured in water, the cube calculates the time to be drawn well and alarms so that users can enjoy the best taste and scent of various teas.

Meanwhile, CES (Consumer Technology Show), which is the world's largest IT consumer electronics and consumer technology tradeshow, is a good opportunity to figure out the flow of the global electronic industry at a glance and is held on every January by CTA (Consumer Technology Association).

AVING News Korea, which have reported issues of CES, MWC, and IFA as the world' three major technology exhibitions the most for the last 10 years, will send a special group of reporters to CES, report main issues of the markets, and introduce Korean enterprises all over the world this year.
